description: Suggest a workout for the person to approve in the Metrics Nest app. This only leaves a suggestion: nothing is planned until they approve it on their phone, where they can also edit or reject it, and no workout is ever created, changed or deleted here. Call list_exercises first and give each exercise its exercise_id from there whenever it is one they have done; for one they have not, take its exercise_id from list_exercise_catalog when the app has it, and otherwise leave exercise_id out and give the name. Weights are kg. Make up a new idempotency_key for each suggestion and send the same one only when retrying this exact call: a retry answers the suggestion already made instead of making a second. Works only where the person allowed this connection to suggest workouts (get_profile says can_propose). list_proposals shows what became of each suggestion.

activity.description: strength (default), run, ride, hike, swim, row, yoga, hiit or other.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

exercises.description: In the order they are to be done.

exercise_id.description: An id from list_exercises. Omit for an exercise they have not done.

notes.description: A cue for this exercise, one line.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per suggestion; the same key again returns the first suggestion instead of a duplicate.

planned_for.description: The day it is meant for, in the account time zone: today up to 28 days ahead.

rationale.description: Why this session, in a few sentences the person reads before approving.

title.description: What the session is, as the person will see it: "Upper body A".

name: propose_workout
title: Suggest a workout
